speed.notes: 25 feet, fly 35 feet; swift steps, tenebral form;

traits.name: Shadow Shift
traits.text: Being made partially of shadow themselves, shae are concealed in dim light or darkness even to creatures that can see clearly in those light levels.

traits.name: Counterattack
traits.text: ⬲ Requirements The shae is aware of the attack Trigger The shae is targeted by an attack from an adjacent creature that misses due to the shae being concealed Effect The shae makes a Strike against the attacker.

traits.name: Slip
traits.text: ⬲ Trigger A creature moves adjacent to the shae Effect The shae teleports to a clear space adjacent to another creature they can see within 30 feet.

traits.name: Bide
traits.text: ⬺ The shae prepares to take action against their foes, watching their opponent and waiting for the right opportunity to respond. The shae gains a second reaction until the start of their next turn, though they still can't use more than one reaction on the same triggering action.

traits.name: Swift Steps
traits.text: The shae's movement doesn't trigger reactions.

traits.name: Tenebral Form
traits.text: The shae can Fly at full Speed in gaseous form.

actions.name: Melee
actions.text: ⬻ dagger +13 (agile, finesse, versatile s); Damage 1d4+5 (1d4+5) piercing and 1d6 (1d6) cold

actions.name: Ranged
actions.text: ⬻ dagger +13 (agile, thrown 10 feet, versatile s); Damage 1d4+5 (1d4+5) piercing and 1d6 (1d6) cold
